verdict.rationale: Zep documents per-user Context Graphs and ABAC policies attached to API keys and UserGroups that limit which context each agent and Memory MCP user can reach. That gives selective access across agents and users while keeping other context restricted. However, the evidence never explicitly describes a shared team or group memory graph, or how selected memory is shared versus kept private. missing for 10: explicit documented shared/group memory graphs, a mechanism for marking selected memory as shared versus private, examples of multi-agent or multi-user sharing, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can share selected memory across multiple agents or users (team or group memory) while keeping private memory private

citations.quote: Limit which actions and context each agent and Memory MCP user can reach with ABAC policies attached to API keys and UserGroups.
Use policies when you need least-privilege access to context for agents and Memory MCP users.
Attribute-based access control governs API keys and UserGroups.
